uncertainties.issue: Translator doubt ruled: kept. 'Rei no renchuu' means the group the speaker already knows of, so 'the ones I heard about' supplies only what 'rei no' implies and 1620 confirms the Gekko crew had been told about them. A fully neutral alternative would be 'So those are the ones?'.

Translator doubt ruled: kept. 'Former chief of the SOF 1st Mobile Unit' is a literal rendering of the source; no official English name for the unit was found, so it remains a glossary proposal, not a verified term.

'Sumanai' here is politer than Holland's 'sumanee' in 1607, but the row has no <ed()> and continues into 1614, which is unmistakably Holland, so it was read as Holland answering Jamil's order in 1612.
